name: Constellation Card
description: A card with a field of dots where a constellation lights up and joins on hover or focus.

props.name: seed
props.description: Picks the constellation and which dots twinkle. The same seed always gives the same sky.

props.name: size
props.description: Stars in the constellation. From five up, the stars form a ring with one more inside it on a spur; fewer make an open chain.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Card content shown under the field: a title, a line of text, an action.
